def factor_volume_price_corr(df):
    """Rolling correlation between price and volume changes."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_chg = df_copy["volume"].pct_change()
    corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=5).corr(vol_chg)
    corr = corr.fillna(0.0)
    corr.name = "factor_volume_price_corr"
    return corr
description: Captures co-movement between daily price changes and volume changes via rolling 20-day correlation. High positive correlation suggests trend confirmation by expanding volume (liquidity-driven momentum); negative correlation may indicate volume spikes on reversals (liquidity absorption). This is a novel price-volume dependency measure, not a simple moving average or stacked indicator.
